description: Players newly listed as out ("opened"), open entries with a new type, reason or suspension length, or off or back on the club's medical report while another source keeps them open ("updated", with changed, suspension and club_report), and players no longer listed ("closed", with closed_reason), newest first, from the last 14 days. Healthy scratches and loans are not included. Use next_cursor as cursor for older changes.

since.description: Only changes from this date or time on (ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-10-27").

team.description: The club: its slug or its name ("EV Zug", "SCRJ Lakers"). The slugs: ajoie (HC Ajoie), ambri (HC Ambrì-Piotta), bern (SC Bern), biel (EHC Biel-Bienne), davos (HC Davos), fribourg (Fribourg-Gottéron), geneve (Genève-Servette HC), kloten (EHC Kloten), langnau (SCL Tigers), lausanne (Lausanne HC), lugano (HC Lugano), rapperswil (SCRJ Lakers), zsc (ZSC Lions), zug (EV Zug).
